raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fixes #55725. GLM-5.3-Flash crashes at weight load on multi-node (2×8 H100) with `KeyError: 'layers.11.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight'` on every second-node worker, while single-node runs fine.

## Root cause

With 2 nodes the run is pipeline-parallel (PP=2), so layer 11's params exist only on stage-0 ranks. The attached log (`layer11.log`) shows all `Worker_PP1_TP0..7` crashing; PP0 is clean. The normal load path guards every weight with `is_pp_missing_parameter` (glm5next/common/model.py), but the two FP8-dequant fast paths bypass it and index `params_dict` directly:

- `_try_load_fp8_attn_proj` → `params_dict[target_w]` (the traceback in the issue)
- `_try_load_fp8_indexer_wk` → `params_dict[fused_name]` (same class of hole)

On a PP rank that doesn't hold the layer, `params_dict` has no such key → KeyError before the normal path ever gets a chance to skip the weight.

## Fix

In both fast paths, return `False` when the target param is absent from `params_dict`, so the weight falls through to the normal path, which skips it via `is_pp_missing_parameter`. The indexer-wk guard is placed *before* buffering, so PP ranks also don't accumulate fp8 tensors that nobody loads. Behavior on ranks that hold the layer is byte-identical.

## Verification

No multi-node GPU here, so verified by driving both functions directly with the exact crashing weight names, on the MI350X pod against the patched module:

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| PP1-style params_dict (layer 11 absent), fp8 `q_a_proj` weight + scale | not consumed, nothing loaded → falls to normal skip path (was: KeyError) |
| PP0-style control (BF16 `fused_qkv_a_proj` present) | consumed + loaded, unchanged |
| PP1, indexer `wk` weight + scale | not consumed → normal skip |
| PP0 control, indexer `wk` | consumed + loaded, unchanged |

Pre-commit: all hooks pass. Single-node (TP-only) behavior is untouched — the guards only trigger when the target param is missing.

Same KeyError on a single node: `--tensor-parallel-size 4 --pipeline-parallel-size 2` on 8× H100 (image `vllm/vllm-openai:glm53-flash-cu129` as pulled on 2026-08-26, sha256:3b9ab05f…) fails in the PP1 workers with `KeyError: 'layers.11.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight'`, while TP8 on the same node loads fine. So PP=2 on one node is enough to verify the fix; no multi-node setup is needed. The code comments say PP is gated off, but `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration` inherits `SupportsPP` from `Glm4vForConditionalGeneration`, so `--pipeline-parallel-size 2` passes the config check and the failure only shows up in the loader (`_try_load_fp8_attn_proj` in `vllm/models/glm5next/common/model.py`).

Thanks — that's a much easier repro, and it confirms the diagnosis: the failure is the loader, not anything multi-node-specific. / index `params_dict` directly for layer names that only exist on the PP stage that owns layer 11, so any PP>1 rank without the layer hits the KeyError. (The fix in this PR guards both lookups and lets those weights fall through to the normal `is_pp_missing_parameter` skip path — verified on MI350X with the exact crashing weight names.) If you pull the branch, the single-node TP4/PP2 repro should load clean; if you'd rather not build, I can post the patched module for your image.

Sorry — markdown escaping glitch in my last comment: the two functions are `_try_load_fp8_attn_proj` and `_try_load_fp8_indexer_wk`, and they index `params_dict` directly for layer names that only exist on the PP stage owning that layer. Any PP>1 rank without the layer hits the KeyError before the normal `is_pp_missing_parameter` skip path is reached.

Your single-node TP4/PP2 repro on 8×H100 should load clean with this branch — the guards make both fast paths decline for PP-missing layers and fall through to the standard skip.

detail.title: [Bugfix] Skip FP8-dequant fast paths for PP-missing layers in GLM-5.3-Flash load

files.patch:
@@ -1236,6 +1236,10 @@ def _try_load_fp8_indexer_wk(name, tensor, buf, params_dict, loaded_params):
     if not is_weight and not is_scale:
         return False
     layer_prefix = name.rsplit(".wk.", 1)[0]
+    # PP rank that doesn't hold this layer — let the normal path skip it
+    # (is_pp_missing_parameter); also avoids buffering tensors nobody loads.
+    if f"{layer_prefix}.wk_weights_proj.weight" not in params_dict:
+        return False
     entry = buf.setdefault(layer_prefix, {})
     entry["weight" if is_weight else "scale"] = tensor
     if "weight" not in entry or "scale" not in entry:
@@ -1334,6 +1338,10 @@ def _try_load_fp8_attn_proj(
     # handle it (it has a weight_scale_inv param).
     if target_s in params_dict:
         return False
+    # On PP ranks that don't hold this layer, let the normal path skip it
+    # (is_pp_missing_parameter); there is no param to load into here.
+    if target_w not in params_dict:
+        return False
 
     entry = buf.setdefault(layer_prefix, {}).setdefault(key, {})
     entry["weight" if is_weight else "scale"] = tensor
